builds.name: Reference: Spacing mage
builds.goal: Reference for Cassiopeia: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A sustained spell duelist who keeps targets poisoned for repeated Twin Fang damage and uses grounding to punish mobility. Keep poison uptime, finite available mana and landed E casts explicit. E is not a basic attack: Lich Bane requires a real attack and may lose more E uptime than it adds. Mana and movement may convert spacing into additional spell windows.
builds.summary: Mana and movement may convert spacing into additional spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Cassiopeia: Keep poison uptime, finite available mana and landed E casts explicit. E is not a basic attack: Lich Bane requires a real attack and may lose more E uptime than it adds.

Start with the early core (Archangel, then Cosmic or Rylai) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Mana and movement may convert spacing into additional spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. For Q/E use real poison uptime and available mana.
failureConditions: Seraph requires transformation; movement cannot compensate for missing damage or missed skillshots.

The route fails Cassiopeia's stated kit question: Keep poison uptime, finite available mana and landed E casts explicit. E is not a basic attack: Lich Bane requires a real attack and may lose more E uptime than it adds.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Seraph requires transformation; movement cannot compensate for missing damage or missed skillshots.
Full cost 16,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Archangel, then Cosmic or Rylai. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: Only the existing Cassio Q/E or Sett W adapter is numerical. Item/rune effects and attack/utility objectives outside that adapter require manual tests.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.
